如果一个游戏跟半成品一样就别拿出来卖！！ 首先我想问那个路障存在的意义是什么？是个人就能拆路障让路线规划变得毫无意义，辛辛苦苦聚好怪被对面破路直接破防，这就算了关键是路障还会挡友方角色的攻击，还有的能挡有的不能挡，教学还不教角色信息也不区分？我拍出来10级弓箭手和火法和傻子一样待路障后面好玩吗？路障没有减cd加血量的天赋就算了，唯一相关天赋是那个路障变裂隙的天赋，好嘛裂隙又不能放人又不能放路障又不能拆纯卡自己，逆天玩意。 然后我们看到逆天的防御塔升级系统，一座塔能升10级还能每级点一个天赋，这很好，那我问你3级塔+4级塔为什么只能点1次天赋？那么只要我升级不是用9次1级塔，亏的天赋你给我补吗？再然后是防御塔进化可以给不是10级的塔用但是不补天赋？这亏的天赋又是你给我补吗？给防御塔进化不能预览，道具又不能稳定获取，那我规划什么呢？ 数值平衡崩坏我就不多提了，就看减价天赋和几个减cd天赋你就能感觉作者纯纯初中数学没毕业，技能强度数学期望算不明白。自动释放技能-40%cd的遗物加上初始角色的上挑斩减15scd，直接让人原地尬舞上挑20分钟我玩什么呢？ 操作手感逆天我就不多提了，普攻放技能停顿的手感多屎玩过的都懂，尤其点名初始角色的踏前斩冲出一个屏幕更是纯纯逆天 游戏流程更是屎啊，重复打3轮塔防算1次通关究极意义不明？我出门以为自己通关了出来发现只打了三分之一直接挠头？为什么要打3轮呢？3轮塔防有什么区别呢？展示没人能看懂用处的地图彩蛋吗？还是展示全是bug的第三关水上出怪？ 别刷好评了，玩通关一把不喷你直接找我。

So, was a bit wishy/washy on whether to buy it or not. Watched 1 streamer, read reviews, but gave it a go anyway since the sale put it under a snack run's price ^_^. First game: I got a Fire Amulet relic, which converts burn damage by my hero/followers into healing. Then, my second relic, I saw Pillar of Symbiosis, which shares healing received, but all minions gain 3 burn stacks every 10s. I wondered if this would combo with the fire relic, but I was confused at first by the phrase 'minions', and didn't know what it meant, but clicked it. Minions does effect followers, as they got the burn animation. I did work like I thought it did though, granting my entire force healing over time (or they just outhealed it, not too sure). I like abilities/relics/perks that combo with one another, so I thought that was great. Second Game: Nothing really excting. Just parked a lightning mage at the front with my tank. Third game I died to those offscreening cannons. For the damage they deal, they are very, very tanky. Beat it on the rematch. Tried the witch hero next, got to 2nd gate, died to cannons. Unlike the warrior hero, couldn't get even close to the cannons without the hero dying, didn't feel like there was much I could do about them. :/ Game also started to feel a little same-ish, so called it for session 1. My feedback so far is: 1) I would love if this game got Windowed Fullscreen so I'm not either trapped in window mode, or forced into fullscreen which minimizes the game whenever I alt tab. 2) Make the auto pause whenever you scroll over a tavern unit to buy an optional toggle. 3) Maybe make assasin followers prioritize cannons/ranged enemies, or make it an upgrade to do so? Though, considering their range, the assassin might not even be able to get to them. 4) More events or something for player engagement? I'll give it a tentative thumbs up, has potential, keep up the good work!

If you look at this game you will see a game with UI that looks slapped together in 10 minutes. Not even using a fancy font for any UI elements An artstyle that cannot decide if it wants to look like a modern game or something off a ♥♥♥♥♥♥ flash game website from 20 years ago and an insane price point at 10$. I bought it anyways... Ok ok hear me out If you look past the janky and ♥♥♥♥♥♥ UI Its pretty fun, not close to being a masterpiece but it's dumb fun My main gripe with recommending it now is, A the game isn't worth the price, and B, with how high the price is and how rough and amaturish the game actually looks and plays I question recommending it to anyone. QUite frankly i wouldnt have bought this if I didn't play the demo Its uhh rough to recommend even if i personally like it. Because I'm used to looking past the awful UI stuff you might see in rougher games I know most people aren't though. The demo was good while it was an option to see if you would actually like it or if the jank was to much for you but without the demo I think your probably safer just scrolling past this [Edit: The dev put the demo back up, mad respect. Honestly I recommend you play the demo 100% if you are remotely interested in this game its fun but janky the only good way to find out if the jank is to much for you is to hop on the demo. I will say odds are if you enjoy the demo you will like the game, I still stand by the fact its over priced would probably say its like a 5$ game in its current state, I mean lets be real here 10$ with what at the very least look like AI assets is very rough, like hard to defend even if i like the game rough But sadly steam doesn't have a buy on sale button so I'mma flip it to positive for now. But 100% play the demo before even thinking about touching the purchase button lmao]

It's a fun game and the idea behind it is good. The gameplay itself is rather enjoyable as well. But that's where the praise stops. It's buggy, unbalanced, and undeveloped. - The first two levels are kind of a cakewalk. As long as you place down units at all you seem to be able to win, but the third level suddenly picks up, but only in the last five minutes for the most part. - The meta progression is there just for the sake of meta progression since you can essentially unlock everything after like 4-5 runs. - Enemies spawning from the side often get stuck on the side and while they occasionally still attack your barricades and units right next to it, they don't do anything anymore after. - You can even block their spawn point and essentially have them spawn outside the map as well. - Occasionally your hero just doesn't attack at all - The speed up 2 button icon is missing - The enemy attacks seem to have random timings and ranges. Sometimes I have a bunch surrounding my tank and nothing happens, but then I have one enemy five tiles away that suddenly one-shots another units with little to no attack indication. - Some of it is dependent on the meta progression, but in just the second difficulty my units almost insta die near the end, including my hero, so you are forced to spend a lot of money and/or exp on simply hp and even that might not be enough. As a whole the game is nice, but with the current issues I can not recommend it.

评价为正式版的价格买了个EA版本品质的游戏，目前不推荐 你如果以后要加入一些什么内容来让现在显得不合理的数值变得合理起来，那么就直接降价出EA版本慢慢做。你如果要出正式版那就更多的去考虑我应该如何平衡现有的数值来使这款游戏的整体开荒体验不至于那么吃屎 算上demo版本现在进度是lv8外加难度解锁到血战前夕。随着游戏进度的推进基本感觉敌方在增强而我方在变弱。 英雄技能池太杂而局外科技又不提供ban选，导致前期随不到好技能在高难度下全程像条区一样蠕动 三图新增的水都两路防守但是栅栏总会留一条小缝，虽然看到有提但是有没有一种可能玩家等不到你出栅栏联动玩法就直接跑路了 终极随从进化的令牌获取途径太少。虽然新版本增加了护卫马车的获取途径，但是马车刷在怪堆里经常就直接暴毙，高难度下根本没有精力去护卫马车。我不能说开发者不会做游戏但是设计确实只能用一坨来形容 最后还有那意义不明的三关无继承，完全看不出设计理念是什么

已经好久没玩到这么好玩的塔防游戏了，希望可以多出一些随从和英雄，另外能不能多做几张地图选择，老是同一张地图有点腻

[h1]城门血战，血战城门[/h1] 选择一个剑士，开始你的城门防御之路，在面对汹涌而来的敌人，你能否守住你的城门呢？ 就英雄而言，每提升1等级可以进行一次进阶，有普通、稀有、史诗和传说品质，当英雄到达一定等级的时候，可以选择一次英雄觉醒，有主动技能、被动技能以及觉醒技能，同时在游戏过程中会产生不同的任务，完成任务目标将会获得一次奖励。 同时，在酒馆里会不定期刷出各种NPC，你可以将它放在地图上的防御处。使用相同的随从可以进行一次等级提升，可从多个技能中选择一个。 过程中，随处而来的商人在他那可以购买两大类道具，一类是放置类道具，这类道具可以放在地上对你的随从进行额外加成，比如说增强雷暴伤害、增强恢复度、增强护甲等等。另外一类则是主动技能或者是随从技能，可以带来额外增益。 游戏不定期会产生各种boss，当击败boss后，则会获得遗物，遗物都非常强大，一定要利用好。就拿过程中的一局来说，前一秒爆了一个免疫火焰伤害的遗物，我没有选择，结果下一个boss竟然是火焰伤害的炎王，不出其难的输掉了比赛。 同时，当你的遗物或者是任务时，有一种可以获得一个古王令，这个古王令非常有意思，可以对你的随从进行觉醒，比如说弓箭手就可以换成一个是穿透的，另外一个是打各种伤害的。而投石机则可以换成燃油投石机或者随从投石机。甚至在法师类，法师则可以变成雷电法师，或者是依据你魔能币提高数量提高额外伤害的法师。在多次对战中，让我印象最深的莫过于一个全屏aoe的boss,非常考验玩家的躲避能力，。这局不出所料的死亡次数过多又输了。 而在我成功通关的这一局，一方面升级了3个古王之令，有3个传说随从，另外一方面，在一个遗物选择上，我获得了终极随从，就是眼前这个火龙，它可以对前面进行燃烧爆炸伤害，同时，这一局我将燃烧伤害加至最大，整体思路都是围绕燃烧来的。果不其然，这一局打得非常轻松，而最后的boss打起来也非常easy，最终取得了胜利。 就我体验下来，《城门血战》其实也是需要一定的运气成分以及运营技巧，在你多次死亡后，额外的解锁英雄，以及你可以将获得的点数放置你的增益系统，让你的生命值，攻击等都有一个额外的加成。整体体验下来，游戏还算蛮有趣的，特别是其中的随机属性让人欲罢不能，玩完一局还想再一局，好玩，推荐！ [quote]欢迎关注『 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45525570/] 桃你欢心 [/url]』 [b] 桃影扶风评百戏，落墨如歌写人间[/b][/quote]

整体而言游戏很上头，个人而言可以给到T 1塔防精品。到不了夯的原因是还有很多优化： 1、角色不平衡，最强角色骑士糊的时候后期万血万攻，比城墙还城墙，输出断档第一，还能给城墙回血；剑士也可以卡无敌状态无限单体斩击，秒boss轻而易举。而某个刺客角色只能偷偷刮痧，一不小心就融化，实力差距巨大。 （注：只把弱的角色提升，别把强的角色砍了，那很掉游戏体验，会被喷的；个人建议提升从技能机制入手，比如刺客的瞬岚，触发条件改一改，去除脱战3秒才能再次使用，改成3秒自动用，配合觉醒，那肯定爽，玩家要的就是成型后的爽感。） 2、塔池太杂了，英雄池技能也杂，解锁越多越杂，全解锁后成型难度大了一半。 （游戏制作组说已经在弄局外封禁了，就不多说了，这点很棒。个人建议高难度可以加个局外养成---初始遗物栏位；开局就送局外自选的遗物，因为发现不同角色都有自己适配度很高的遗物，拿到很容易开爽。） 3、难度和优化可以深入一下。 （这个是最后才弄的，难度是可以开个无限ro深渊模式等等，主要是看着自己几万血几万攻的大骑士，成型后却爽不了几分钟，有感而发；优化是因为这样的骑士成型后却开始卡顿掉帧起来了，哈哈哈。）
数值很不合理，低难度随便玩，高难度几乎没有技巧纯靠运气，。 不能扳选，拿不到好点的随从和技能，几分钟后就只能重开。

Only downside to the game at the moment is that it gets very grindy . It takes quite a while to beat the game on max difficulty and you only get about 700 gems for doing so. If you want to unlock all unit upgrades, that is 63000 gems and that is not even counting the gems you need to upgrade everything else.
